proposals.subtype: Replace monitor-list overloads with typed collection-result factories
proposals.explanation: Four suppressions accompany sync/async GetAll replacements that construct typed result objects, forward cursors/limit/agent name, stringify an optional order and adapt cancellation through ToRequestOptions. The bodies do not implement next-link traversal or locally supply the documented limit/order defaults.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The Custom partial class has explicit suppressions and complete replacement method bodies.

proposals.subtype: Construct typed monitor-run collection results with filter adaptation

proposals.handwrittenRationale: The Custom partial class explicitly suppresses the corresponding generated signatures and implements these factories.

proposals.subtype: Construct typed insight collection results with optional filters
proposals.explanation: GetInsights/GetInsightsAsync guard monitorId and construct typed results with stringified order/severity/status plus category, nullable includeDetails and cursor arguments. proposals.subtype: Customize connection-provider construction and authentication pipelines

The source cannot establish whether this member effects a usable model override rather than an inert partial declaration, or whether a generator could produce its intended mapping.

limitations: Only 6 of 778 eligible files among 964 discovered files are captured. The six files are complete, but generated counterparts, collection-result implementations, authentication/connection/cache helpers, telemetry, model converters, voice clients and most operations are absent.

All six evidence items have handwritten-marker provenance under Custom, reinforced by explicit suppressions/type associations. A handwritten declaration is not proof that a specific generated type/property was replaced or that comments' runtime claims hold.

Constructor bodies differ materially: settings/policy construction does not initialize the captured connection manager or telemetry-details field, while the token-provider path does. The token path's base initializer dereferences options before its null fallback. No source execution or uniform-construction guarantee is claimed.

Pipeline helper calls show configured hooks, not their implementations. The conditional API-version predicate excludes paths containing openai/v1 case-insensitively; header mutation, error/input transforms and fine-tuning parity behavior cannot be reconstructed from helper names.

AuthorizationScopes is declared but the captured bearer policy uses an uncaptured _flows value; the declared scope is not assumed to be the actual active flow. Realtime construction uses _flows[0], but flow contents and handshake/streaming behavior are unavailable.

Volatile/read plus compare-exchange publishes cached references but can allocate losing candidates under contention. Public properties are grouped with their matching factories; the differently named memory-stores helper is explicitly kept separate rather than conflated.

The typed collection factories forward null/default arguments and enum ToString results. Documented server defaults, enum wire spellings, iteration, cursor/next-link behavior and request-options conversion are not independently established.

Model declarations show get-only Uri and internal error members, without assignments, conversion/absolute-URI validation or failure-only population logic. Same-name CodeGenType annotations are not counted as type renames.

Private constants, shared-source/package references, empty bodies and Experimental annotations are not separate behaviors. IncludesOperationsSharedSource and multipart imports do not establish an LRO or multipart customization in the captured implementation.

Project beta.6 differs from latestRelease beta.5 and the stable metadata label is not treated as authoritative release status. Generator-addressable labels are plausibility judgments, not implemented capabilities or measured recurrence.

Only six of 778 eligible source files were captured from 964 discovered files; review-budget skips include many Custom files and helpers. These decisions classify supplied evidence only, not all SDK customizations or their absence.

The captured files are labeled handwritten-marker and live under Custom, but generated counterparts, several called helpers, referenced collection-result classes and downstream SDK behavior are unavailable. Code statements are distinguished from comments, documentation and hypotheses; no generator compilation diagnosis, runtime effect or helper internals are independently verified.

The captured csproj documents a 3.0.0-beta.6 version while the library metadata reports latestRelease 3.0.0-beta.5; release metadata is not reconciled. No runtime/build or external source validation was performed, and accepted means AI-reviewed rather than verified.
